en.title: Daily Action Flow, September 25, 2026
en.description: Eight bounded actions connect preferences, deployment, capital and usable cash.
en.centralJudgment: Trace the obligation to an accepted outcome. The settlement essay is complete as an editorial artifact; seven other actions remain proposed or under observation. Neither a production announcement nor a funding round completes the downstream test.
en.fieldLine: Eight signals. Clear owners. Evidence of completion.

actions.title: Define a preference-fidelity test
actions.why: An autonomous system needs a test of preference fidelity alongside execution quality.
steps: Specify a ten-choice synthetic preference test, with owner rankings hidden from the agent and pairwise agreement as the acceptance metric; keep execution proposed and grant no transaction authority.
Save sample design and a pairwise-agreement metric before any authorized test. No synthetic run has been performed.
actions.done: READY; specification recorded, execution pending.

actions.title: Retain Atlas training-stage classification
actions.why: This is a specific new observation for the existing humanoid evidence framework, distinct from yesterday's global shipment denominator.
steps: Retain a training-stage classification until the customer discloses one repeatable production task with accepted output, human assistance and all-in operating cost.
Require accepted output, assistance and full cost for one repeatable task. Training evidence cannot establish unit economics.
actions.done: WATCHING; production evidence condition retained.

actions.domain: Crypto Capital Flows and Web3 Health
actions.title: Keep ETF flow confirmation bounded
actions.why: A dated flow observation can update the capital picture without converting it into an order or a claim of portfolio performance.
steps: Keep the flow-confirmation watchpoint open until the next complete session can be compared with both ETF breadth and independently measured onchain activity; do not infer missing activity from ETF totals.
Archive the dated flow snapshot and require independent activity evidence. This remains a watchpoint, with no order or portfolio action.
actions.done: WATCHING; next complete session and activity evidence pending.

actions.title: Specify a settlement comparison
actions.why: Payments experience helps separate network settlement from the business's ability to use and reconcile its cash.
steps: Define one comparison sheet for card settlement routes using eligibility, prefunding, usable-cash timing, reconciliation and total disclosed cost; leave unavailable terms unfilled.
Use one row per route and preserve unavailable commercial terms as UNKNOWN. No payment or customer-data access.
actions.done: READY; comparison specification recorded, execution pending.

actions.title: Publish The Weekend Settlement Gap
actions.why: This connects financial operations and systems design in a distinct editorial asset, with a practical question a merchant can understand.
steps: Publish “The Weekend Settlement Gap” (Chinese working title, translated: “The Weekend Settlement Gap”) at [today's canonical Action Item](https://iamrobin.ai/ouroboros/202609/20260925/action_item/). Thesis: faster settlement creates value when it delivers usable, reconciled cash. Evidence spine: SoFi's plan-to-live change; four payment clocks; Visa and FedNow alternatives; a clearly hypothetical liquidity calculation; a bounded evidence sheet. Use the original SoFi, Mastercard, Visa and Federal Reserve sources. Archive a LinkedIn derivative with the four-clock diagram for Robin's manual distribution.
Complete five-source research, four authored editions, a conceptual diagram, ledger linkage and an archived LinkedIn derivative. Public delivery is verified separately.
actions.done: COMPLETE for the editorial artifact; delivery has separate release gates.

actions.domain: AI Infrastructure, Career and Capital Projects
actions.title: Record the reported delay allocation
actions.why: Mapping energy delivery, rent commencement and debt service is an infrastructure underwriting and career skill; this reporting establishes no job opening.
steps: Save one public-evidence delay-allocation dossier distinguishing the reported notice, each company's position and the missing contractual trigger; make no legal conclusion or private-project change.
Preserve the Reuters attribution and both company positions. The contract and trigger remain UNKNOWN; the private evidence router follows publication.
actions.done: READY; evidence-dossier assignment recorded, contractual determination UNKNOWN.

actions.title: Keep HEO at WATCH
actions.why: The round offers a capital-and-systems research case without establishing accessible allocation, profitable utilization or an arranged exit.
steps: WATCH; change to INVESTIGATE only after repeatable GEO service, customer concentration, margin after sensor costs, financing terms and actual access are evidenced.
Require operating evidence and accessible terms before changing classification. No allocation, application or arranged exit is claimed.
actions.done: WATCHING; INVESTIGATE evidence threshold unpassed.

actions.title: Freeze a Micron pre-results card
actions.why: Memory economics need evidence on demand, supply commitments, margin and cash conversion rather than a share-price narrative alone.
steps: Save a pre-results watch card that changes the thesis only on disclosed memory demand, binding supply commitments, margin and cash conversion, then compare it with the released figures after the call.
Record demand, binding commitments, margin and cash conversion questions before the call. Results remain unavailable until released.
actions.done: WATCHING; pre-results questions recorded, no earnings outcome assumed.

運用証拠とアクセス可能な条件でのみ分類を変更。投資枠取得、申請、出口確定は主張しない。
actions.done: WATCHING。INVESTIGATE証拠条件は未達。

actions.title: Micron決算前カードを固定
actions.why: メモリーの経済性には需要、供給契約、利益率、現金化の証拠が必要で、株価の物語だけでは足りない。
steps: 開示されたメモリー需要、拘束力のある供給約束、利益率、現金化だけで仮説を変える決算前観察カードを保存し、説明会後に公表値と比較する。
説明会前に需要、拘束力ある約束、利益率、現金化の問いを記録。公表までは結果を利用できない。
actions.done: WATCHING。決算前の問いを保存し、結果は仮定しない。
